item.title: Sudan's lost generation: War is stealing a generation of childhood
item.description: Three years of war have stolen childhood from millions of children in Sudan, leaving them displaced, hungry and fighting for survival instead of learning in a classroom.
item.content:encoded: Three years of war have stolen childhood from millions of children in Sudan, leaving them displaced, hungry and fighting for survival instead of learning in a classroom.

item.title: Contrary to popular belief, foot traffic and spending at malls is up
item.description: This is the biggest shopping weekend for the American mall, which — despite widespread belief to the contrary — is not dying. One reason? Teens and tweens have rediscovered the hangout.
